args.body:
label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

parseAmount in src/util/money.ts removes only a hardcoded set of currency characters /[\s€$£¥]/g when parsing amounts. We should update parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to strip out any leading or trailing currency symbols/letters instead of only hardcoded €, $, £, ¥ (e.g. handle ₹, CHF, and general currency signs/codes).
